data.exact_reserve_text: Prior year reserve movements resulted in a GBP 4.1m strengthening in 2014, compared to a GBP 0.5m release in 2013 (see Note 2). Net claims incurred includes prior accident year reserve strengthening totaling GBP 4.1 million (2013: GBP 0.5m release).
data.standardized_narrative: For the 2014 financial year, Syndicate 4141 experienced a net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 4.1 million. This adverse development was primarily attributed to several large losses that occurred towards the end of 2014, despite a generally benign catastrophe environment. The strengthening represents 2.59% of the opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: Prior year reserve movements resulted in a GBP 4.1m strengthening
did experience several large losses, particularly towards the end of 2014

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of GBP 4.1 million is explicitly stated as 'net' in the report. No gross prior year development figure was available from any source (movement note, narrative, or claims development triangle).
